news.title: Why the old enrollment playbook no longer works
news.summary_en: Key points: The demographic cliff higher education has been warned about for years isn’t coming; it’s already here. The post-2008 birthrate drop is now hitting institutions directly, arriving alongside affordability…

news.title: Invisible translators: What funky techs do for higher ed
news.summary_en: You don’t see ‘funky tech’ in scholarly literature. But if you’ve spent time at higher-ed tech conferences, you’ve heard it. Someone introduces themselves during a networking break: “I’m a funky tech over in Academic Advising.”
